ranked.headline: Deep learning models predict variant effects, mutation rates and assembly errors

ranked.summary: May 2026 preprints and publications extend learned sequence and structure models to multi-objective design and directed evolution.

ranked.summary: Spatial and single-cell datasets now span weakly linked modalities, multiple samples and batches, demanding integration that preserves biology.

ranked.summary: Matched multi-platform spatial benchmarks and cell-resolved inference frameworks now allow direct comparison of niche-level methods on shared tissue.

ranked.headline: Protein language model embeddings adapted for function, binding, and site prediction
ranked.summary: Recent papers test how pretrained protein language model embeddings perform under low-homology, data-limited, and unseen-label regimes.

ranked.headline: Evaluating statistical methods for omics data: bias, error control and replicability
ranked.summary: Recent work tests omics methods under controlled pathologies and quantifies bias and replicability rather than reporting biological findings alone.

ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications extend graph learning to knowledge graphs, residue-level structures, and metabolic hypergraphs.

ranked.summary: Long-read RNA sequencing requires benchmarked tools for isoform reconstruction, single-cell quantification, and variant calling.

ranked.summary: Structure-aware tools now deliver residue-level mapping, PTM annotation, and fold comparison at database and genome scale.

ranked.summary: Assembly-free and reference-independent tools now enable viral phylogenetics and surveillance directly from unassembled metagenomic reads.

ranked.summary: Learned and physics-based models now extract organelle-, histology-, and section-level information from existing multimodal imaging and omics data.

ranked.summary: Annotated particle datasets and self-correcting alignment models target bottlenecks in cryo-EM and cryo-ET data processing.

ranked.headline: Open, standardized tools and public datasets advance microbial genome analysis
ranked.summary: Reproducible, open workflows now span metadata integration, read-quality effects, hybrid metagenomics, and plasmid tool benchmarking.

ranked.headline: Methylation and chromatin profiling extended to low-input, spatial, and repetitive DNA
ranked.summary: Methylation and chromatin resolution is now being carried into fragmented, FFPE, spatial, and repeat-rich DNA settings.

ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication apply probabilistic and generative models to sequence design, ancestral reconstruction, and RNA structural ensembles.
